open.title: Open your account
open.invalid: This is not a valid address. Check it and try again.
open.noCamera: The camera could not be opened. You can paste the address instead.

payment.title: Did my payment arrive?
payment.placeholder: Paste the transaction code or an address
payment.notArrivedText: It did not go through. The money did not leave the sender's account; only the fee was taken.
payment.notYou: If your address is not in this list, this code did not pay you.
payment.more: This code may have more transfers than shown here. If your address is not in this list, we cannot tell from here whether this code paid you.
payment.notAPayment: This code is not a payment.
payment.failedNotAPayment: This code is not a payment, and it did not go through.
payment.notFound: We could not find this payment yet. If you just sent it, wait a minute and try again.

state.error: This could not be loaded. Try again later.

cid.edit: Add a photo and name on this device
cid.localNote: The photo and name stay on this device only; they are never sent anywhere.
cid.notImage: This file is not a picture.
cid.notSaved: This browser will not keep them; they show only until you close the page.
